retain_attachment_ids.description: Create tickets allow 30 attachments; other types allow 20. Each file is at most 32 MiB, total 96 MiB; empty .in/.out files are allowed.

attachments.description: Create tickets allow 30 attachments; other types allow 20. Each file is at most 32 MiB, total 96 MiB; empty .in/.out files are allowed.

join_code.description: 仅系统管理员和团队管理人员可见

ranking_user_ids.description: 排名和奖项换算名单；null 为全体，空数组为不排名。不会限制提交权限。草稿/退回状态可编辑，审核通过时冻结。

CaseSummary.description: 提交绑定的不可变版本测试点统计；隐藏、未完成或无自动评测结果时为 null

review.description: JSON TicketPackageReview; mutually exclusive with package.

icon_url.description: PNG/JPEG/WebP data URL or existing image URL; blank uses team icon.

test_mode.description: 保留、按名称合并（保留遗漏测试与原权重）、明确完整替换。省略时兼容 replace_tests。

Forbidden.description: 权限不足；考试范围限制返回 code=EXAM_SCOPE_REQUIRED 和 exam_id

ServiceUnavailable.description: 服务或权限状态暂不可用；AUTH_STATE_UNAVAILABLE / EXAM_STATE_UNAVAILABLE 不表示退出登录或解除考试锁
